page_title: BAR 2-0 CAD | Barcelona v Cadiz CF 20/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+6' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz).
90+4' 2 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Ferran Torres (Barcelona) was set free in the area by Robert Lewandowski and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
90+3' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Ruiz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+1' The Barcelona players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Alejandro Ruiz signals NO GOAL following the VAR review.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Barcelona score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
90' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Ansu Fati (Barcelona) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.

89' Ansu Fati (Barcelona) wastes an opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
87' It is time for a substitution. Alvaro Negredo (Cadiz) is on for Alex Fernandez.
87' We are about to witness a subsitution. Milutin Osmajic (Cadiz) for Chris Ramos.
86' Sergio prepares a substitution. Roger Marti is replaced by Jose Mari (Cadiz).
85' Substitution. Lamine Yamal walks off the pitch and Ferran Torres (Barcelona) comes on as a substitute.
85' Ansu Fati (Barcelona) tries to catch the keeper off guard from long range, but the effort sails well wide of the right post.
82' 1 - 0 What a goal! Ilkay Gundogan plays it to Pedri (Barcelona), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Jeremias Ledesma into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
81' Barcelona take a short corner kick.
80' Ansu Fati (Barcelona) takes the corner with a short pass.

80' Abde Ezzalzouli (Barcelona) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the top left corner is, however, superbly saved by Jeremias Ledesma! The ball goes out of play and Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
79' Oscar Hernandez decides to make a substitution. Andreas Christensen will be replaced by Eric Garcia (Barcelona).
79' Substitution. Oriol Romeu is replaced by Sergi Roberto (Barcelona).
77' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
77' Ansu Fati (Barcelona) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley well wide of the left post from inside the box.
76' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
73' Pedri (Barcelona) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
72' A long cross into the box finds Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) unmarked, but his header from the edge of the six-yard box is wild and goes miles wide of the left post.
68' Alejandro Balde will be replaced by Ansu Fati (Barcelona).
68' Substitution. Abde Ezzalzouli (Barcelona) has come on for Gavi.
68' Here is a change. Ivan Alejo is going off and Sergio gives the last tactical orders to Darwin Machis (Cadiz).
68' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Fede San Emeterio as he is replaced by Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz).
66' Fede San Emeterio (Cadiz) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Alejandro Ruiz stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
64' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.

63' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) and his stunning dribble! He zig-zags through the defence and gets in front of the keeper. He faints to shoot and then suddenly strikes goalwards, but his effort misses the target by a whisker. Very unlucky for Chris Ramos (Cadiz). This could have been a legendary goal.
63' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Jeremias Ledesma comes off the line to clear the ball away.
62' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
59' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Jeremias Ledesma comes off his line to intercept.
58' Two players stand over the free kick. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
56' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) commits a foul and Alejandro Ruiz immediately signals a free kick.
54' CHANCE! Gavi (Barcelona) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
54' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
53' The resulting corner from Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is cleared by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
53' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Barcelona get a corner.
52' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) receives the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort that sails well wide of the right post.
51' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
51' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Barcelona will take a corner.
50' The attendance is 39603.

46' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
46' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) hits a shot towards the left side of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Jeremias Ledesma.
46' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' Gavi (Barcelona) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) fires the ball from the free kick just outside the box, but he misdirects his shot high over the bar.
45+2' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to Fede San Emeterio (Cadiz) for his blatant foul.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
42' The game is interrupted. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
40' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
38' Luis Hernandez (Cadiz) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.

35' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Roger Marti (Cadiz) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen pulls off an easy save.
35' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

34' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the right post. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
31' A cooling break is underway.
30' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) launches a cross from the corner, but Jeremias Ledesma is alert to thwart the effort.

30' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Barcelona.

29' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) gets inside the box and tries to beat Jeremias Ledesma with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner.
28' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
26' Marc-Andre ter Stegen (Barcelona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Ruiz had an easy-decision to make.
26' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
21' Pedri (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
19' Gavi (Barcelona) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
17' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
15' What a save from Jeremias Ledesma! Pedri (Barcelona) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
14' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) was quite harsh and Alejandro Ruiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
13' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box finds Chris Ramos (Cadiz), whose header flies way wide of the left post.
10' Pedri (Barcelona) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
10' Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player. Now Barcelona have a corner.
8' Barcelona are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
5' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
2' Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) works the corner short.
1' The ball is cleared after Chris Ramos (Cadiz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Barcelona will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Ruiz got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
